values.title: Selective sourcing
values.description: Pieces are chosen for their construction, character, and potential — not simply because they are available. The focus is quality, usefulness, and what each piece could become.

values.title: Thoughtful transformation
values.description: Each piece is assessed individually, then repaired, refinished, painted, waxed, or updated as needed. The goal is not to force every piece into the same style, but to give it a clear second life.

values.title: Local and personal
values.description: This is a hands-on local operation. Pieces are sourced, transformed, and sold within the community — not shipped from a warehouse or produced at scale.

process.title: The find
process.description: Sourced from estate sales, auctions, and private collections. We look for quality construction and character.

process.title: The work
process.description: Each piece is assessed, repaired, and transformed by hand. Paint, wax, hardware — whatever it takes to bring it back.

process.title: The listing
process.description: Finished pieces are listed on Facebook Marketplace. Current inventory is always there — updated as pieces are completed.
